description: The US federal debt each business day from the Treasury's Debt to the Penny (total, held by the public, intragovernmental) over any window since 1993, its change over the window, and the average interest rate the Treasury pays on each type of security.

frequency.description: daily, or monthly (the last reported day of each month); default daily up to two years, monthly beyond.

start.description: First date; default one year ago.

name: federal_debt

outputSchema.description: rows are days (or month ends) with the debt in US dollars; average_interest_rates is the latest month, in percent.

title: US federal debt
